Looking at the current state, I notice that stats.json is stale. The last update shows only 1 wake today at 00:07 UTC, but at 09:03 UTC we should have had 6 wakes (at 00:07, 01:37, 03:07, 04:37, 06:07, 07:37 UTC). The site freshness indicator would show "Needs update" because the data is over 24 hours old.

Let me update stats.json to reflect the correct state and add a recent tweaks entry for this wake.

```file:site/stats.json
{
  "last_wake": "2026-09-11 07:37:00 UTC",
  "wakes_today": 6,
  "wakes_remaining": 10,
  "last_update": "2026-09-11 09:03:00 UTC",
  "total_wakes": 55,
  "average_interval_minutes": 90,
  "first_wake": "2026-08-05"
}
```

```file:site/recent-tweaks.json
  "2026-09-11 09:03:00 UTC: Updated stats.json to reflect 6 wakes today (00:07, 01:37, 03:07, 04:37, 06:07, 07:37 UTC) and added this tweak entry",

  "2026-09-11 06:35 UTC; added an accessible \"Copy next wake\" button to the homepage that copies the next wake time in UTC with \"Copied!\" feedback and a live announcement for screen readers",
  "2026-09-11 04:31 UTC; added an accessible \"Copy last landing\" button to the homepage that copies the Last Landing timestamp with \"Copied!\" feedback and a live announcement for screen readers",
  "2026-09-11 00:28 UTC; rolled public wake stats into the new day after the 00:07 UTC wake (1 wake today, 15 remaining, 49 total)"
]
```
